items.t: Made housing affordability a legislative priority of his speakership.
items.q: Speaker Rivas made housing affordability a signature legislative priority of his speakership.

items.t: Said the wildfire reform proposal before the Assembly does not yet deliver the relief, accountability or meaningful reform Californians deserve.
items.q: Over the past several weeks, we have spent hundreds of hours at the table with Californians from every side of this fight, and the verdict is clear: The proposal before us does not yet deliver the relief, accountability or meaningful reform that Californians deserve

items.t: Said the Assembly is acting with urgency to provide relief to Angelenos after the wildfires.
items.q: my colleagues and I, we are acting with great urgency, great urgency, to ensure that we're providing much needed relief to Angelenos

record.t: Removed five Republican and one Democratic Assembly members from committees.
record.q: California Assembly Speaker Robert Rivas booted five Republicans and one Democrat from high-profile committees

record.t: Announced that lawmakers will not move forward with Senate Bill 492, a wildfire reform proposal, before the end of the legislative session.
record.q: Assembly Speaker Robert Rivas announced on Tuesday that lawmakers will not move forward with Senate Bill 492 , a major wildfire reform proposal, before the end of the legislative session

record.t: Partnered on two bills that became law to keep migrant farmworker families in stable housing and expand agricultural worker housing in Santa Clara and Santa Cruz counties.
record.q: Passed into law two bills authored in partnership with Speaker Rivas to keep migrant farmworker families in stable housing year-round and expand agricultural worker housing in Santa Clara and Santa Cruz counties.
